purpose: Reset the Hero Dungeon supplemental validation scope so canonical Hero population is reused from the frozen Hero consumer while only Heroes with an explicit non-empty DungeonLevels_ID[] participate in Hero Dungeon cardinality and ordinal validation.

scope.goal: Validate HeroInformationInfo.DungeonLevels_ID[] -> HeroDungeonLevelInfo.ID -> HeroDungeonLevelInfo.NameNum for the frozen canonical Hero population without recomputing primary Hero identity, Fetter semantics, or Stage 5/6 outputs.
inScope: Classify each frozen canonical Hero as NO_HERO_DUNGEON or HAS_HERO_DUNGEON from explicit DungeonLevels_ID presence/content.
Exact-ID JOIN every explicit DungeonLevels_ID value to HeroDungeonLevelInfo.ID.
Use HeroDungeonLevelInfo.NameNum as the sole gateOrdinal authority.
Validate per-Hero NameNum presence, positive-integer form, uniqueness, and explicit ordinal-set integrity.
Apply Hero Dungeon cardinality acceptance only to HAS_HERO_DUNGEON Heroes.
Record observed 5-gate and 7-gate populations and fail closed on any other non-empty population, including 6.
outOfScope: Recompute or refilter the canonical 267-Hero population from ConfigDataHeroInfo.
Reopen or regenerate Hero Stage 5 or Stage 6 frozen outputs.
Infer gateOrdinal from DungeonLevels_ID array position, DungeonLevel ID arithmetic, PreLevel_ID, Fetter count, filename, name similarity, or UI order.
Create frontend, localization, asset, release, or presentation changes.

noHeroDungeon.when: DungeonLevels_ID is absent, null, or an empty array on the canonical Hero's HeroInformation record.

hasHeroDungeon.when: DungeonLevels_ID is an explicit non-empty array on the canonical Hero's HeroInformation record.

populationAcceptance.note: The validator must measure the snapshot before publishing counts; this contract does not predeclare the number of 5-gate or 7-gate Heroes.

stages.name: authority-and-scope-freeze
stages.completion: Reuse frozen Hero 267 and pinned source-pack authority; freeze in-scope/non-scope and fail-closed rules.

stages.name: population-classification
stages.completion: Classify all 267 canonical Heroes into NO_HERO_DUNGEON or HAS_HERO_DUNGEON and publish observed non-empty cardinality distribution.

stages.name: exact-join-integrity
stages.completion: All explicit DungeonLevels_ID values resolve by exact ID with no dangling or duplicate source references.

stages.name: namenum-ordinal-integrity
stages.completion: Every joined stage has a valid NameNum; no per-Hero duplicate NameNum; no fallback inference is used; observed ordinal sets are explicit and valid.

stages.name: population-acceptance
stages.completion: Every HAS_HERO_DUNGEON Hero has exactly 5 or 7 joined stages; count 6 and every other non-empty count fail closed as BLOCKER.

stages.name: supplemental-final-freeze
stages.completion: Freeze the Hero Dungeon supplemental ordinal facet and summary without changing the primary Hero lifecycle or Stage 5/6 frozen consumers.

blockers: Frozen canonical Hero consumer is not exactly 267 unique Hero IDs.
Pinned ConfigData source-pack identity or hydration fails closed.
A canonical Hero cannot be matched to its explicit HeroInformation record without an already-validated ID relation.
An explicit DungeonLevels_ID has no exact HeroDungeonLevelInfo.ID target.
A joined HeroDungeonLevelInfo has missing or invalid NameNum.
A Hero has duplicate NameNum values within its explicit DungeonLevels_ID set.
A HAS_HERO_DUNGEON Hero has 6 stages or any other non-empty cardinality outside 5 or 7.
Any implementation introduces array-order, ID-arithmetic, PreLevel-order, name-based, filename-based, or UI-order inference.

handoff.nextStart: Implement a read-only supplemental validator that enumerates the frozen hero-detail/by-id consumer, resolves the pinned ConfigData source through the maintenance resolver, classifies DungeonLevels_ID presence, and only then reports the observed population distribution. Do not publish B1 counts before executing that validator.
